Howz remote monitoring technology enables care providers to identify who needs the most support and precisely when it is required.

Our service is used for assessment, reassessment and reablement.

# The future of proactive and preventative care

[ASSESSMENT REPORT](https://www.howz.com/assessment-report)

#### Howz uses remote monitoring technology to build a round-the-clock view of behaviour at home. We identify the key indicators of wellbeing deterioration to enable interventions at the point of need.

## Our clinical expertise

Co-founded by physiotherapist Louise Rogerson and data scientist Jonathan Burr, Howz combines clinical expertise with advanced machine learning algorithms so we can accurately detect indicators of risk.

Working hand in hand with the Dementia Research Institute and the University of Lancaster, our technology and clinical approach is based on deep scientific rigour.

We analyse every user as an individual with their own needs & circumstances for personalised and proactive care.
